title: Flat map flattens nested iterators
prompt: What error occurs when you use map instead of flat_map on a closure that returns an iterator?
answer: The compiler produces type error `E0308` because `map` creates an iterator yielding inner iterators rather than individual elements. Downstream adapters receive an iterator item type instead of the inner value type. Using `flat_map` flattens the nested stream lazily into a single sequence.
